    Oriented trees #

    For a graph G and an orientation o of its edges, OT G o has an arrow a → b when o a b. If G is a forest, two paths with the same ends agree (RayCat.OT.path_eq), the quiver is acyclic, and its underlying graph is G. The local cleaving criterion then only asks for nonzero path images and for non-factorization between different branches at each vertex (RayCat.OT.arrowCleaving).
